title: resourceIdentity
responsibility: Validates owner ancestry and process start identity, and identifies abandoned stale leases conservatively.

inputs.name: resourceIdentity.job
inputs.description: One lease with its owner PID, start identity, reservation and heartbeat.

inputs.name: abandonedResources.jobs
inputs.description: Ordered shared queued and running reservations, including each parent identity and requested budget.

inputs.name: abandonedResources.rows
inputs.description: Observed process rows with parent relationships and start identities; unavailable identity is never assumed valid.

inputs.name: abandonedResources.now
inputs.description: Current epoch time in milliseconds for telemetry freshness, queue ordering or lease expiry.

outputs.name: resourceIdentity
outputs.description: Whether this process descends from the still-current owner PID and start identity.

outputs.name: abandonedResources
outputs.description: IDs with stale heartbeats whose owner and tracked worker are both proven absent.
